item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 18/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China in the next few days. Tropical Cyclone Man-yi near Luzon will move across the central and northern parts of the South China Sea today and tomorrow. It will then move in the general direction of the vicinity south of Hainan Island. Under the combined effect of Man-yi and the northeast monsoon, it will be windy and rainy over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days. Temperatures will fall progressively and there will be swells. With Man-yi departing from the coastal areas and weakening gradually, showers will ease off and it will become brighter over the region in the latter part of this week. Another surge of a strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong over the weekend, it will be windy and remain slightly cooler in the morning and at night over the region.
